Third-party libraries bundled into the single-file build (`studio/tools/build_single_file.py`)
so the editor and video export work offline. All MIT licensed (JSZip: MIT or GPLv3).

- konva.min.js — Konva 9.3.22 (canvas scene graph)
- mp4-muxer.js — mp4-muxer 5.1.5 (MP4 video export)
- webm-muxer.js — webm-muxer 5.0.4 (WebM video export)
- jszip.min.js — JSZip 3.10.1 (reading uploaded font .zip files)
